description.value:
The Pathfinder archetype is a Scout Routine built around movement — across terrain no map has ever properly charted, through environments that would strand a less prepared traveler, and always one step ahead of whatever is hunting them. Pathfinders are the Scouts other Scouts call when a job requires going somewhere first.

A Pathfinder gains supernatural ease of movement across difficult terrain, the knack of finding safe routes and resources where none seem to exist, and the ability to guide a whole party through conditions that would otherwise grind an expedition to a halt.
